text: This Report recommends approval of the application to amend the Zoning By-law, with a Holding Provision, to permit the redevelopment of the lands with a 29-storey (90.5 metres, 96.5 metres including mechanical penthouse) residential apartment building with 316 units (Building B) at 25 Cedarcroft Boulevard. The lands currently contain a 13-storey residential apartment building with 132 rental units (Building A) and a surface parking lot. The existing building will be retained, and one (1) rental unit will be added to the existing building. The existing surface parking lot will be removed to accommodate the proposed building. Improvements to the existing building and the site will also be provided, as well as providing a portion of a future Multi-Use Path connecting Bathurst Street and Antibes Drive. City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend City of Toronto Zoning By-law 569-2013 for the lands municipally known as 25 Cedarcroft Boulevard substantially in accordance with the draft Zoning By-law Amendment included as Attachment 1 to the supplementary report (July 24, 2026) from the Interim Executive Director, Development Review. 2. City Council determine that, pursuant to Section 34(17) of the Planning Act, no further notice is required. 3. City Council authorize the City Solicitor to make such stylistic and technical changes to the draft Zoning By-law Amendment as may be required. 4.
